INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_ATM_CUSTOMER_SELECT_SRC
(
				 [CUST_ID]
				,[CUST_NUMBER]
				,[CUST_TITLE]
				,[CUST_FIRST_NAME]
				,[CUST_MIDDLE_NAME]
				,[CUST_LAST_NAME]
				,[CUST_CCNY_ID]
				,[CUST_GENDER]
				,[CUST_DOB]
				,[CUST_EMAIL_ADDRESS]
				,[CUST_STATUS]
				,[CUST_WORK_PHONE]
				,[CUST_MOBILE_PHONE]
				,[CUST_DEVICE_ID]
				,[CUST_CCAT_ID]
				,[CUST_NAT_CTY_ISO_ID]
				,[CUST_CUSTOM_DATA]
				,[CUST_CREATED_DATE_TS]
				,[CUST_LAST_UPDATE_TS]
				,[CUST_LIMIT_CONFIG]
				,[CUST_HOME_PHONE]
				,[CUST_CUIT_CODE_1]
				,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_1]
				,[CUST_CUIT_CODE_2]
				,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_2]
				,[CUST_CUIT_CODE_3]
				,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_3]
				,[CUST_ISS_ID]
				,[CUST_RESIDENCE_IND]
				,[CUST_BACKGROUND_IND]
				,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_1_EKY_ID]
				,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_2_EKY_ID]
				,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_3_EKY_ID]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
				 CC.[CUST_ID]
				,CC.[CUST_NUMBER]
				,CC.[CUST_TITLE]
				,CC.[CUST_FIRST_NAME]
				,CC.[CUST_MIDDLE_NAME]
				,CC.[CUST_LAST_NAME]
				,CC.[CUST_CCNY_ID]
				,CC.[CUST_GENDER]
				,CC.[CUST_DOB]
				,CC.[CUST_EMAIL_ADDRESS]
				,CC.[CUST_STATUS]
				,CC.[CUST_WORK_PHONE]
				,CC.[CUST_MOBILE_PHONE]
				,CC.[CUST_DEVICE_ID]
				,CC.[CUST_CCAT_ID]
				,CC.[CUST_NAT_CTY_ISO_ID]
				,CC.[CUST_CUSTOM_DATA]
				,CC.[CUST_CREATED_DATE_TS]
				,CC.[CUST_LAST_UPDATE_TS]
				,CC.[CUST_LIMIT_CONFIG]
				,CC.[CUST_HOME_PHONE]
				,CC.[CUST_CUIT_CODE_1]
				,CC.[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_1]
				,CC.[CUST_CUIT_CODE_2]
				,CC.[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_2]
				,CC.[CUST_CUIT_CODE_3]
				,CC.[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_3]
				,CC.[CUST_ISS_ID]
				,CC.[CUST_RESIDENCE_IND]
				,CC.[CUST_BACKGROUND_IND]
				,CC.[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_1_EKY_ID]
				,CC.[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_2_EKY_ID]
				,CC.[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_3_EKY_ID]
				,CC.[FILE_NAME]
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.ATM_CUSTOMER CC
			JOIN d360.STG_EDS_ATM_CUSTOMER B 
			ON CC.CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID
			AND CC.BNK_CODE = LEFT(B.FILE_NAME,5)
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';

				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT

from 
(
	SELECT 				
				 [CUST_ID]
				,[CUST_NUMBER]
				,[CUST_TITLE]
				,[CUST_FIRST_NAME]
				,[CUST_MIDDLE_NAME]

				,[CUST_NAT_CTY_ISO_ID]

				,[CUST_LAST_UPDATE_TS]

				,[CUST_CUIT_CODE_2]
				,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_2]
				,[CUST_CUIT_CODE_3]
				,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_3]

				,[CUST_RESIDENCE_IND]
				,[CUST_BACKGROUND_IND]

				,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_2_EKY_ID]
				,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_3_EKY_ID]
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME

				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_ATM_CUSTOMER_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY     [CUST_ID]
				,[CUST_NUMBER]
				,[CUST_TITLE]
				,[CUST_FIRST_NAME]
				,[CUST_MIDDLE_NAME]
				,[CUST_LAST_NAME]
				,[CUST_CCNY_ID]
				,[CUST_GENDER]
				,[CUST_DOB]
				,[CUST_EMAIL_ADDRESS]
				,[CUST_STATUS]
				,[CUST_WORK_PHONE]
				,[CUST_MOBILE_PHONE]
				,[CUST_DEVICE_ID]
				,[CUST_CCAT_ID]
				,[CUST_NAT_CTY_ISO_ID]
				,[CUST_CUSTOM_DATA]
				,[CUST_CREATED_DATE_TS]
				,[CUST_LAST_UPDATE_TS]
				,[CUST_LIMIT_CONFIG]
				,[CUST_HOME_PHONE]
				,[CUST_CUIT_CODE_1]
				,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_1]
				,[CUST_CUIT_CODE_2]
				,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_2]
				,[CUST_CUIT_CODE_3]
				,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_3]
				,[CUST_ISS_ID]
				,[CUST_RESIDENCE_IND]
				,[CUST_BACKGROUND_IND]
				,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_1_EKY_ID]
				,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_2_EKY_ID]
				,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_3_EKY_ID]
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_ATM_CUSTOMER]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.ATM_CUSTOMER A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_ATM_CUSTOMER_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.CUST_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.CUST_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BNK_CODE,'-1') = COALESCE(LEFT(B.FILE_NAME,5),'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1
